data.one_liner: A 3D game engine for Flutter built on Flutter GPU with PBR lighting and glTF support.
data.what_it_does: Renders 3D scenes, glTF models, and geometries with PBR lighting, shadows, physics, and animation using Flutter GPU. It runs on mobile, desktop, and the web, and includes a desktop scene editor and asset pipeline.
use_when: You want to build 3D games or interactive graphics experiences within Flutter.
You need glTF model rendering with PBR lighting and shadows across all Flutter platforms.
avoid_when: You only need standard 2D UI layouts and standard Flutter widgets.
You are running on Flutter versions that do not support Flutter GPU or you cannot enable it.
strengths: Built on Flutter GPU for native-tier performance across mobile, desktop, and web.
Supports PBR materials, physics, positional audio, and skeletal animation.
Includes a build-time asset pipeline for optimization and a scene editor.
weaknesses: Requires enabling Flutter GPU flags and specific platform setup.
Asset pipeline and shader compilation require build hooks.
data.setup_notes: Requires running `dart run flutter_scene:init`, enabling Flutter GPU in platform configuration files or command-line flags, and Flutter 3.47.1+ for some native targets.

alternatives.name: flame
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a mature 2D game engine with extensive component and ecosystem support.
